title: Make migration import of a large store finish in bounded time instead of rescanning the whole store in late validation
outcome: Make migration import of a large store finish in bounded time instead of rescanning the whole store in late validation
acceptance: The phase that dominates `engram migration import` time on a store of TermAl's size class (about 2.4 GB) is identified by measurement, not inference
Import of that store size completes in a measured, bounded time with the same integrity guarantees (integrity check, projection repair, verification), with no validation step dropped or weakened
A test or measurement shows import time growing roughly linearly with row count rather than repeating whole-store scans per phase
